title: 345 - Snake Rattle Roll
method: claude-code: written from the transcript, links verified by script

items.name: Snake Rattle 'n' Roll
items.description: The episode's game: Rare's 1990 isometric platformer where two snakes eat nibbly pibblies to grow and weigh in.

items.name: Rare
items.description: The British developer of Snake Rattle 'n' Roll, later known for Banjo-Kazooie.

items.name: Banjo-Kazooie
items.description: Rare's later N64 platformer, whose lack of last names and shark scare the hosts compare to this game.

items.name: Donkey Kong
items.description: Nintendo series whose characters, like Diddy Kong, share a last name, in a joke about snake surnames.

items.name: Super Mario Bros. (film)
items.description: The 1993 live-action movie where Mario and Luigi both have the last name Mario.

links.label: Wikipedia: Super Mario Bros. (film)
links.note: 1993 film by Rocky Morton and Annabel Jankel

items.name: Pixar
items.description: Animation studio the hosts imagine making a modern Rattle and Roll movie.

items.name: Snake
items.description: The Nokia phone game the snake-head gameplay recalls.

items.name: Nokia
items.description: Phone maker whose phones popularized the game Snake.

items.name: Isometric video game graphics
items.description: The angled 3D-looking perspective that makes the D-pad controls tricky.

items.name: Crash Bandicoot
items.description: Full 3D PlayStation platformer mentioned for its shadows that help judge jumps.

items.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
items.description: Game compared to the snakes losing part of their tail instead of health.

links.label: Wikipedia: Sonic the Hedgehog (1991 video game)

items.name: Marble Madness
items.description: Isometric NES game ported by Rare, compared for its smooth movement and perspective.

items.name: Bigfoot
items.description: The cryptid and the giant foot enemy and final boss in the game.

items.name: Game Boy
items.description: Nintendo handheld that got Sneaky Snakes and that level seven's stage layout spells out.

items.name: Sega Genesis
items.description: Console version in which the level's layout was changed to say Go Sega.

items.name: Shake, Rattle and Roll
items.description: The 1950s rock song the game's title and music play on.

links.label: Wikipedia: Shake, Rattle and Roll
links.note: Song first recorded by Big Joe Turner in 1954

items.name: Jaws
items.description: The shark movie whose theme the in-game shark music resembles.

items.name: Solstice
items.description: The earlier isometric NES puzzle game whose controls didn't work for one host.

items.name: Atari 2600
items.description: Console joked about as having poor controls that would make an essential list hard.

items.name: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
items.description: Next week's game, the early text-menu dungeon crawler RPG.

items.name: Splatterhouse
items.description: The horror game the hosts will play in its cute Famicom version for the Patreon bonus show.
